data.long_meaning: The name Suthar is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Surya', which means 'Sun'. This name is for a boy and is used to represent the Sun God in Hinduism. The name is believed to bring wisdom, power, and light into the life of the child. The name Suthar carries the meaning “Sun God” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Suthar usually hope their child will grow to embody sun god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
